description: EV charging stations near a point. Primary source OpenStreetMap (Overpass): name, operator, network, socket types, capacity, access, hours. For US points when Overpass is unavailable, the US DOE/NREL Alternative Fuel Stations directory is used instead. PlugShare itself has no public API, so its reviews and live status are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
